killed: 64 confirmed DRC / 2 confirmed Uganda = 66 confirmed total
injured: 334 surviving confirmed cases; 233 currently hospitalized in isolation (DRC); 668 contacts under monitoring (Uganda)
note: DRC: 381 confirmed cases (359 Ituri across 17 health zones, 19 Nord-Kivu across 7 health zones, 3 Sud-Kivu/1 health zone) + ~116 suspected under investigation; 64 confirmed deaths. Uganda: 19 confirmed cases (8 Kampala + 1 Wakiso + new contact-linked cases), 2 confirmed deaths. Total confirmed: 400 cases, 66 deaths. CFR (confirmed): 16.5% (66/400). Community deaths in 23%-inaccessible Ituri zones not captured; Mambasa Territory (IS-controlled) now a complete access dead zone. 233 patients currently hospitalized in DRC isolation units. MSF 80-bed ETC in Goma operational; 65-bed ETC under construction in Mongbwalu; ETCs in Bukavu and Lwiro (Sud-Kivu). No licensed BDBV vaccine or therapeutic. CDC MMWR modeling (June 5) warns 10,000–20,000+ cases possible without countermeasure scale-up. Africa CDC–WHO joint $518M continental response plan launched June 5. Pandemic Fund $220.6M approved June 5.

category: West Africa Epidemic 2014–2016 (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone)
note: Official confirmed + probable deaths. Excess mortality estimates 17,000–30,000 total. ~500 healthcare workers killed. Liberia: 4,809 dead; Sierra Leone: 3,956; Guinea: 2,545.

source: WHO / DRC MoH — End of Outbreak Declaration, 25 June 2020
note: 2nd-largest Ebola outbreak in history. CFR 66%. 168 healthcare workers infected, 41 killed. Sustained over 25 months in active conflict zone.
CFR 88% — highest ever recorded for Ebola. Primary amplification through reused syringes at Yambuku Mission Hospital. Isolated community; full case capture likely.
CFR 53%. Concurrent with Yambuku. Cotton factory and hospital workers primary cases. Led to identification of Sudan ebolavirus as distinct species.
CFR 79%. 315 total cases. Amplified through Kikwit General Hospital. Index case was forestry worker. High HCW toll (nurse family clusters).
CFR 53%. 425 total cases. Largest SUDV outbreak on record. Spread along trucking route Gulu-Masindi-Mbarara before containment.

category: Healthcare Worker Deaths — All Outbreaks Combined (1976–2026)
source: WHO Cumulative Health Worker Tracking; CDC
note: Largest single HCW toll: West Africa 2014 (~500 killed). Kivu 2018–2020: 41 killed. 2026 outbreak: 4 killed (as of May 2026). HCW deaths are central to response disruption and community trust breakdowns.

CFR 25% — lowest of any Ebola strain. 149 total cases. Identified new strain BDBV. Index case linked to dead chimpanzee. CFR difference vs EBOV (~60–90%) thought related to different receptor binding.

164 total cases; CFR 34%. No licensed SUDV vaccine available. Mubende District epicenter. Contained without licensed vaccine — contact tracing and ETU care alone. Exposed critical vaccine portfolio gap.
